scientific_update: The new coupled multi-k route actually works within resource limits. The Gamma-only and finite-k execution paths give substantially different same-state model energies; Gamma must not be treated as automatically representative. Agreement of occupations and overlap-trace counts with12 separates the finite realspace quadrature offset from a change of model electron inventory. Neither observation establishes physical accuracy.

why_not_more_k_now: A second mesh already tests whether the world can enter a previously unavailable coupled k-sampled state space. A third mesh would not alone remove quadrature, GDF-covariation, basis or PBE uncertainties, and no mission-relevant material comparison currently justifies an unbounded carbon convergence campaign. Spare compute budget does not create continuation authority.
why_not_new_model_now: No independent model evidence here isolates PBE or basis error, so do not replace the model merely because the quadrature screen warns. No proof that the current method is physically false.
